fit_prophet_model: fit a Prophet time series forecasting model with linear or logistic growth on time series data
predict_prophet_forecast: predict future values with a fitted Prophet model for a specified number of steps ahead
create_prophet_params: create ProphetParams with custom growth, seasonality, changepoints, and extra regressors for time series forecasting
predict_uncertainty_intervals: generate prediction uncertainty intervals for yhat and trend using posterior predictive sampling
get_prophet_parameter_search_space: get the default parameter search space dictionary for Prophet model hyperparameter tuning
